blocks.text: 实际用起来是这样的

inlines.text: 实际用起来是这样的

blocks.text: 假设你的团队正在筹划一场客户活动，Claude 也在会议里。你说一句“Claude，为这个方案建个文档”，Claude 就会把团队到目前为止说过的内容整理成文，受邀的同事可以在你们继续讨论的同时编辑这份方案。

inlines.text: 假设你的团队正在筹划一场客户活动，Claude 也在会议里。你说一句“Claude，为这个方案建个文档”，Claude 就会把团队到目前为止说过的内容整理成文，受邀的同事可以在你们继续讨论的同时编辑这份方案。

blocks.text: 讨论到预算时，有人问 Claude 去年的活动花了多少钱。Claude 会先征得对方同意再去查询，把结果发到会议聊天里，并与当前方案做对比。讨论到时间安排时，有人让 Claude 把它放到白板上，团队便一边看文档一边排日程。

blocks.text: 安全与隐私

inlines.text: 安全与隐私

blocks.text: Claude 会在 claude.ai 上为每场会议单独建一个页面，放上纪要、转录以及它生成的所有内容。受邀的组织成员可以查看并编辑 Claude 生成的内容，也可以从该页面分享给组织内的其他人。

inlines.text: Claude 会在
claude.ai
上为每场会议单独建一个页面，放上纪要、转录以及它生成的所有内容。受邀的组织成员可以查看并编辑 Claude 生成的内容，也可以从该页面分享给组织内的其他人。

blocks.text: 默认情况下，如果受邀者中有组织外的人，Claude 会不加入通话；如果会议中途有外部人员加入，Claude 会退出。管理员可以允许 Claude 参加有外部嘉宾的通话。在这类通话中，Claude 会在通话聊天里发布提示，但不会在那里回复，嘉宾的发言会写入纪要和转录。

blocks.text: Claude 调用每个人连接的工具时，都会取得该本人的许可。第一次会询问，同意后后续默认沿用。目前，如果有人口头提问，Claude 每次都会确认说话人是谁。发在通话聊天里的回答，通话中所有人都能看到。

blocks.text: 如何开始使用

inlines.text: 如何开始使用

blocks.text: 有人添加 Claude 或开启自动加入时，Claude 就会加入。目前支持 Google Meet，其他平台即将推出。在 Team 套餐上，邀请 Claude 参加会议默认可用，管理员可以关闭。在 Enterprise 套餐上，由管理员为整个组织或部分组织开启。测试期间，部分组织暂不可用，包括采用零数据保留（ZDR）、HIPAA 就绪配置或客户管理加密密钥（CMEK）的组织。

blocks.text: 测试期间，Team 和 Enterprise 套餐可免费使用 Claude 的笔记和转录功能。通话中 Claude 给出的回答同样免费，但如果回答调用了你已连接的工具，这部分会计入套餐用量。Claude 在通话中生成的文档、白板及其他产物，在 2027 年 2 月 10 日前均可免费使用。

blocks.text: What it looks like

inlines.text: What it looks like

blocks.text: Say your team is planning a customer event, and Claude is on the call. You say, “Claude, start a doc for this plan.” Claude writes up what the team has said so far, and teammates on the invite can edit the plan while you keep talking.

inlines.text: Say your team is planning a customer event, and Claude is on the call. You say, “Claude, start a doc for this plan.” Claude writes up what the team has said so far, and teammates on the invite can edit the plan while you keep talking.

blocks.text: When you start discussing the budget, someone asks Claude what last year’s event cost. Claude asks for their approval to look it up, posts it in the meeting chat, and compares it to the current plan. When you start discussing timelines, someone asks Claude to put it on a whiteboard, and the team works on the schedule alongside the doc.

blocks.text: Security and privacy

inlines.text: Security and privacy

blocks.text: Claude adds a separate page for each meeting in claude.ai with the notes, transcript, and anything it built. People from your organization on the invite can see it and edit what Claude made, and it can be shared with others in your organization from the page.

inlines.text: Claude adds a separate page for each meeting in
claude.ai

with the notes, transcript, and anything it built. People from your organization on the invite can see it and edit what Claude made, and it can be shared with others in your organization from the page.

blocks.text: By default, Claude is set to stay out of calls when someone from outside your organization is invited, and to leave if someone from outside joins partway through. An admin can allow Claude on calls with outside guests. On those calls, Claude posts its notice in the call’s chat but doesn’t reply there, and what guests say is included in the notes and transcript.

inlines.text: By default, Claude is set to stay out of calls when someone from outside your organization is invited, and to leave if someone from outside joins partway through. An admin can allow Claude on calls with outside guests. On those calls, Claude posts its notice in the call’s chat but doesn’t reply there, and what guests say is included in the notes and transcript.

blocks.text: Claude uses each person’s connected tools with that person’s permission. It asks the first time, and a yes applies going forward. For now, when someone asks out loud, Claude asks each time to confirm who’s speaking. An answer posted in the call’s chat is visible to everyone on the call.

blocks.text: Getting started

inlines.text: Getting started

blocks.text: Claude joins when someone adds it or has auto-join on. Support is currently available for Google Meet, with other platforms coming soon. On Team plans, inviting Claude to your meetings is available by default, and an admin can turn it off. On Enterprise plans, an admin turns it on for all or part of the organization. While it’s in beta, it isn’t available to some organizations, including those with zero data retention (ZDR), HIPAA-ready configuration, or customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK).

blocks.text: During the beta, Claude’s notes and transcripts are free on Team and Enterprise plans. So are its answers in your calls, unless an answer uses one of your connected tools, which counts toward your plan’s usage. The docs, whiteboards, and other artifacts Claude makes in a call are free through February 10, 2027.
